title: 第21章 干第22章 必死无疑
content_zh:
第21章干！
远风城大比结束的第十天，天色阴沉，乌云密布，幽暗笼罩大地。
哒哒哒！
城内各处似乎都回荡着马蹄声，地面震颤，不少人紧闭房门，空气中仿佛都弥漫着杀伐的气息。
也不知马蹄声持续了多久，最终，他们都停留在同一个地方，白府门外。
有城内之人眺望白府的方向，只见白府外黑压压一片，如死亡的铁骑将白府包围，连一只鸟都飞不出白府。
“白府，要完了！”
这几乎是所有人的想法，哪怕白府这些天风光无限，又有萧沉即将踏入祁天学府，然而，在这股恐怖阵容的围剿下，他们只怕依旧在劫难逃。
“青袍甲胄，莫非，这些骑兵是从青甲城而来？”
有人大惊失色，青甲城，乃是祁国东南之地的一座重城，论武道的兴盛程度，远胜远风城。
而青甲城的象征，便是青甲军团。
青甲城的年轻武修，皆以加入青甲军团为荣。
这是一支强劲而精锐的军团，哪怕只是部分降临远风城，也让人闻之胆寒。
众人看到，在白家府门之外正前方的位置，有一将领骑着高头大马，冷漠地注视着白家。
在他的身旁，凌远图、冷家之主，同样骑在马上，面露阴霾之色。
城主府的强者、冷家和周家的长老人物，皆在他们身后。
一场惊心动魄的大战，仿佛一触即发。
“有劳辛兄携青甲军团千里迢迢赶来，凌某万分感激。”
这时，凌远图对着身边的将领说道。
“凌城主此话就见外了，我临行之前，城主曾经交代，他与凌城主乃是多年的好友，凌少城主的死，他非常惋惜，让我务必配合好凌城主，镇压远风城的逆贼！”

那将领朗声说道。
“犬子在天之灵，也会感激青甲城的付出。”
凌远图微微欠身，虽说他也是一城之主，但远风城和青甲城根本没有可比性，这不到一成的青甲军团，都足以横扫他的远风城。
连青甲城主手下的战将辛度，都拥有命桥境修为，他自然不敢托大。
“整个白家，都封锁了吗？”
辛度喝问道。
“启禀将军，白家的任何人，都插翅难飞！”
有兵士单膝跪地，高声回禀道。
“很好，”
辛度微微颔首，随即看向了凌远图，“请城主安排。”
凌远图的马朝前摇晃了两步，他的声音如同洪钟，回荡在白家的上空。
“萧沉，残忍嗜杀，连有养育之恩的义父都敢杀，简直天理难容。
凌某身为远风城的城主，自当匡扶正义，替周家讨回公道。
只要白家愿意交出萧沉，青甲军团马上撤离，如若白家依旧执迷不悟，要与此禽兽为伍，则休怪凌某不顾念多年情谊，大开杀戒！”
哪怕远风城众人明知道凌远图是在捏造罪名，也都不敢多说什么，为了镇压萧沉，他连青甲军团都可以请来，又有谁敢替萧沉说一句公道话呢？
“欲加之罪，何患无辞？凌城主到底是想要主持正义，还是想借机替自己的儿子报仇，我想，天下人自有公论！”
一道年轻的身影渐渐出现在众人的视线之中，他迈着沉稳的步伐而来，脸上似乎还挂着风轻云淡的笑容，像是没有看到门外的千军万马。
content_en:
Chapter 21 Do it!
On the tenth day after the competition in Far Wind City, the sky was gloomy, dark clouds covered the earth, and darkness shrouded the earth.
Ta-ta-ta!
The sound of horse hooves seemed to echo everywhere in the city, the ground shook, many people closed their doors tightly, and the air seemed to be filled with the aura of killing.
I don’t know how long the sound of horse hooves lasted, but in the end, they all stopped at the same place, outside the gate of Baifu.
Some people in the city looked in the direction of the White Mansion and saw the darkness outside the White Mansion. It was like a cavalry of death surrounding the White Mansion. Not even a bird could fly out of the White Mansion.
"The White House is about to end!"
This is what almost everyone thinks. Even though the Bai Mansion is enjoying great glory these days, and Xiao Chen is about to enter Qitian Academy, under the encirclement and suppression of this terrifying lineup, they are still in danger of escaping.
"Qingpao Armor, could it be that these cavalry are coming from Qingjia City?"
Some people were shocked. Qingjia City was an important city in the southeast of Qi State. In terms of the prosperity of martial arts, it was far better than Yuanfeng City.
The symbol of Qingjia City is the Qingjia Legion.
The young martial arts cultivators in Qingjia City are all proud to join the Qingjia Legion.
This is a strong and elite legion. Even if it only partially descends on Far Wind City, it will still be frightening to people.
Everyone saw a general riding a tall horse directly in front of the Bai family's house, looking at the Bai family indifferently.
Beside him, Ling Yuantu and the head of the Leng family were also riding on horses, with gloomy expressions on their faces.
The powerful men from the City Lord's Mansion, the elders of the Leng family and the Zhou family were all behind them.
A thrilling battle seems to be about to break out.
"Brother Laoxin came all the way with the Qingjia Army. Ling is extremely grateful."
At this time, Ling Yuantu said to the general beside him.
"City Lord Ling's words are unheard of. Before I left, the City Lord once confessed that he and City Lord Ling have been friends for many years. He was very sorry for the death of City Lord Ling, and asked me to cooperate with City Lord Ling to suppress the rebels in Yuanfeng City!"
The general said loudly.
"The spirit of the dog in the sky will also be grateful for Qingjia City's efforts."
Ling Yuantu bowed slightly. Although he was also the lord of a city, there was no comparison between Yuanfeng City and Qingjia City. Less than 10% of the Qingjia Army was enough to sweep his Yuanfeng City.
Even Xindu, the general under Qingjia City Lord, has the cultivation level of Life Bridge Realm, so naturally he doesn't dare to trust him.
"Has the entire Bai family been sealed off?"
Xin Duhe asked.
"General Qi, no one from the Bai family can fly!"
A soldier knelt down on one knee and shouted back.
"Very good,"
Xin Du nodded slightly, then looked at Ling Yuantu, "Please ask the city lord to make arrangements."
Ling Yuantu's horse swayed forward two steps, and his voice was like a loud bell, echoing over the Bai family.
"Xiao Chen is so cruel and murderous that he even dares to kill his adoptive father, who was the one who raised him. This is simply unjust.
As the lord of Yuanfeng City, Ling should support justice and seek justice for the Zhou family.
As long as the Bai family is willing to hand over Xiao Chen, the Qingjia Legion will leave immediately. If the Bai family is still stubborn and wants to associate with this beast, then don't blame Ling for not caring about the friendship for many years and going on a killing spree! "
Even if everyone in Yuanfeng City knew that Ling Yuantu was fabricating charges, they did not dare to say anything. In order to suppress Xiao Chen, he could even invite the Qingjia Army. Who would dare to say a fair word for Xiao Chen?
"If you want to inflict a crime, why bother? Does City Lord Ling want to uphold justice, or does he want to take the opportunity to avenge his son? I think everyone in the world can decide for themselves!"
A young figure gradually appeared in everyone's sight. He came with steady steps and a gentle smile on his face, as if he didn't see the thousands of troops outside the door.
